item.description: - New: Meeting Privacy. Windows of private apps (Messages, Mail, Slack, Notes, password managers and more) get a Liquid Glass cover that blurs their content, also for people watching when you share your whole screen. - The cover turns on by itself during a call, for example in Zoom, Teams, FaceTime or Google Meet, and comes off when the call ends. - ⌃⌥P covers or uncovers the app in front. ⌃⌥⇧P, or "Hide private windows" in the menu bar menu, does it for all private apps. - You can still click and type in a covered window. - Settings › Meeting Privacy: choose which apps are private, add your own, and set the glass strength. - When you quit Butterfly, your windows go back to the size and place they had before Butterfly arranged them. - The window you were using stays in view when tiling starts, and a short hint shows how to move between windows. - Settings, License and Permissions windows opened from the menu bar now come to the front and take the keyboard. - You can paste your license key with ⌘V, and ⌘W or Esc closes the License window. - The Permissions window fits on screen, and skipping the tour without Accessibility access now shows it. - The License window shows the price and explains what happens when the trial ends and how to move your key to another Mac. - New Uninstall steps in Settings › General, and the macOS 27 privacy pane is named in the Permissions text. - Windows of apps that open slowly, such as Messages, now join the strip reliably. - Clearer menu bar menu: a Tiling label, and one keyboard shortcut per action, with arrows.

- Closing the last window of a workspace now takes you back to a workspace that still has windows. - Closing the last window while Overview is open now closes Overview. - Dragging the last window of a workspace onto another workspace in Overview now takes you there.

- Motion now starts more smoothly on 120 Hz displays. - Butterfly now uses your Mac's accent color in the menu, Settings, the tour and the license window. - Settings, the tour and the practice strip share one set of greys and one corner scale. - Clearer names: "New workspace", "Start at login" and "Tour…".
